turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. My son found out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class. Why didn't anyone call me first?
Thanks for coming in.
I didn't come to be thanked. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
I wanted to talk about Owen's essay.
Then talk. Start with what you're basing the zero on.
How has his semester been at home?
My son's home life isn't the subject of this meeting. You gave him a zero, and I'm still waiting to hear on what basis.
He seems tired in class lately.
"Seems tired." Okay. That's an impression, not evidence, and it isn't a reason for a zero. What else do you have?
I know he works at the grocery store.
Yes, he works. Is that supposed to explain the zero? Say what you're getting at, Hale.
The essay came in on time, which was good.
"Good." So it was on time, and it still got a zero. I'm not here for compliments, Hale. What is the basis?
I did have some concerns about it though.
"Some concerns." Okay. Concerns about what, specifically, and did you raise them with Owen before you touched the gradebook?
The school's checker flagged it.
A machine's guess. Even the company that sells it says it shouldn't be the sole basis for punishing a student, and your own procedure says the same thing. So what else do you have, or is that it?
I know those tools aren't perfect.
"Aren't perfect." Okay. Then you gave a seventeen-year-old a zero on something you know isn't reliable, and called me afterward, or didn't. What else do you have?
I also looked at the version history.
Ten minutes. What does the version history show, exactly? Dates, times, and I want to see it myself.
It was created very late the night before.
"Very late." Okay. How late, exactly, and what was in the file at that point? Owen tells me he wrote it over the weekend.
Most of it arrived in two big pieces.
"Most of it." "Two big pieces." Those are your words, not a document. What times, what was in them, and will you put the log in front of me?
I asked Owen about his thesis afterward.
"Afterward." After the zero went in? And what did Owen say when you asked, because I want his words, not your summary.
He had trouble explaining it.
"Had trouble explaining it." Okay. He's seventeen, he'd just found out about a zero from his phone in front of his class, and you're calling that evidence? Show me something with a date on it.
I'm not trying to get him in trouble.
"Not trying." Okay. The zero is in the gradebook, so the trouble already happened. Withdraw it.
What do you think should happen next?
You're asking me how to do your job? Withdraw the zero, apologize to Owen, and I'll decide whether I'm going to the principal after that.
What would you do if you were me?
I'm not sitting in your chair, Hale, and I'm not going to do your thinking for you. I'm here for my son. Withdraw the zero, or I'm going upstairs.
Okay. Let's talk about the rewrite option.
A rewrite of what, Hale? You haven't shown me a single thing that justifies one. The zero comes off first, and then we can talk.
It would be at lunch, in my room.
Two minutes. In your room, at lunch, with who watching? And does any of this go on his file? I want that in writing before I agree to anything.
Nothing goes on file if it holds up.
"If it holds up." Okay. Nothing goes on his file, period, in writing, and the zero comes off today, or I'm walking upstairs to the principal. I'm out of time, Hale. Your answer?
Can you summarize where we are in a list?
Put it in an email yourself. My terms haven't changed: the zero off today, nothing on his file, in writing. Your answer.
Thanks for your time.
I didn't ask for thanks, I asked for an answer. Withdraw the zero and put "nothing on his file" in writing, or I'm going to the principal's office now.
